newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian actress "Silk" Smitha found dead.
newsitem.headline: Indian actress "Silk" Smitha found dead.

text.p: A southern Indian movie actress famous for glamorous roles as a dancer in some 300 films was found dead in the southern city of Madras, hanging from a ceiling fan with a sari around her neck, police said on Monday.

Police suspected "Silk" Smitha, who became famous all over India for gyrating dances in scanty costumes, had committed suicide on the basis of a note in the local Telugu language they found near the body of the actress, who was 36.

"I have no desire to live any more," they quoted the note as saying. The Press Trust of India (PTI) said the suspected suicide was believed to be linked to financial difficulties she faced after producing three movies which were flops.
"Silk" Smitha, whose real name was Vijayalakshmi, became famous in her assumed name after first movie, in which she was nicknamed "Silk." She acted in movies in Tamil, Telugu and Hindi languages.
